definition.simple: When you mix things together but they don't chemically change into a new substance.
definition.academic: A material consisting of two or more substances (elements or compounds) that are mixed together physically but not chemically combined.

common_misconceptions: Assuming mixtures must be liquids. Mixtures can be solid, liquid, or gas.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Can you separate the parts of the substance easily by physical methods like filtering or picking?
